name: lattice-linux-agent
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y mesa-vulkan-drivers libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libxcb1-dev g++ gcc xvfb xdotool x11-utils ffmpeg && sudo update-alternatives --set cc /usr/bin/gcc && cargo fetch --locked && cargo build --workspace
